summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @hubsync/web-sdk-react@6.3.20 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, marks it executable, and immediately invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB Bun-only bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) obfuscated with a shuffled string array (`n7gIxM=[...]`) rotated by `WV8StW`, and hex-mangled identifiers, preventing inspection of its behavior. The package presents itself as `Verdocs Web SDK for React` while being published under the unrelated `@hubsync` scope, a name/publisher mismatch consistent with typosquat/impersonation. No React SDK legitimately requires fetching an alternate language runtime to execute a large opaque bundle at install time; this pattern fits the alternate-runtime-dropper shape, where fetching Bun defeats standard Node-based auditing of what actually runs on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
